nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The Long Haul idles outside the gate: three trucks, patched, one with a bedframe welded on as a plough.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Morning. Don't get up. I mean that, I'm selling, not asking.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Actually I'm asking. Road through the Ruins. I need guns on the wheels.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: We lost two outriders this month. Juniper's still limping.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Dee thinks I'm too nice. Dee's right. Pay's good though.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Is that a bed on the front?

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Plough, kid. Bed was its first job. Everything has a second job now.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Fuel, seed, a crate of medicine for a place that's still there. And people. Six of them.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Something you can't buy. I'll teach you to build a bike. Two wheels, a prayer and a muffler.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: There is no around.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: We roll at noon. Stay near the wheels. Wheels are cover. Hoods are targets.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Evening. The Long Haul's trucks tick and cool inside the fence.)

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: He was in the cab. He said he'd get out. He always gets out.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: Long Haul's mine now. Prices go up. The road doesn't care, so I won't either.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: He wanted you to have the bike plans. Here. He drew the muffler himself. Badly.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Six people. Six. You know what they're worth on the market? Nothing. Good.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Lost the fuel. Lost the seed. I'll find more. I can't find more of them.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: You get Long Haul prices from now on. Family prices. Don't tell anyone, they'll all want to be family.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: And the bike. Sit down. Two wheels, a prayer and a muffler.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: We got the fuel through.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Two of the six didn't. Hannah and the boy.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: You did what I asked. I asked wrong.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Count the people. Then count the cargo. In that order. ...I'll be saying that to myself for a while.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Everybody. Every crate. You know how often that happens? I'll tell you. Today. Once.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: Don't let it go to his head. It's already gone to his head.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: You're breathing. Good. The trucks are still sitting at the Flats. Nobody rolls without you.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Road's worse, though. Two more Husks out on the verge since you went down.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Come when you can walk. Stay near the wheels this time. Wheels are cover.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I've got someone. Mall frequency. They've been on loop for three days.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (A recording. Crackle.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: —clinic's open. Mall, pharmacy wing, south stairs. Bring your own bandages, we're out. Clinic's open—

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Loop's changed today. Listen.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Live.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: —water's up to the second shelf. If anyone's out there I have a man on the table and I am NOT stopping.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: That's live. That's now.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Of course you are. Pharmacy wing. Bring a med-kit for him and patience for her.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: It's a mall full of water and dead people. Define safe.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Nice Med Bay. Who built it, a carpenter?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Shows. I'll fix it.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Is his leg gone?

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Half of it. The other half's wood now. Wood's fine. Wood doesn't get infected.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: You asked if he was worth it. Don't ever ask me that about anyone in this colony.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Here's my rule, so nobody's surprised. A leg is a leg. Wood, steel, carbon, I don't care.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: The head is where the person is. Nobody touches the head. Not you. Not them. Not me.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: I wasn't asking. I'm staying. Your bandages are a disgrace.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Sleep. Then a better Med Bay. Then a hospital, but let's not get ahead of ourselves.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: {survivor:most_injured}. Sit. You've been walking on that like it owes you money.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Mechanical. Springs and a socket. No power, no upkeep, no nonsense.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: That arm's better than the one you were born with. Don't tell your mother.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The clinic band's gone quiet. No loop. Nothing.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: She didn't stop. Right to the end, she didn't stop. That was the whole point of her, I think.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Her notes came home with you. Limb plans, every spring drawn by hand. Somebody read them properly.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...Sorry. I'm going off-air for a minute.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You made it out. Good. She didn't. Not yet. She's still in there.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: She sealed the clinic herself. Shelves against the doors. She's been holding out alone, and she's hurt.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: She's still on the band, swearing at the water. Go back for her.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I want to see the Rail Depot. I can't. Nobody's been in or out for two years.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Can't you just look?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: With what, kid, my eyes? I live in a hole.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I had a drone. It went down in the Mall atrium. Bring me its core and I'll give you its brothers.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Drones! Can I fly one?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...If your people say yes. And if you don't crash it into a Husk on purpose.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Core's talking. Sending her up. Watch the map.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The scout drone crosses the Ruins and the Mall. The Rail Depot fogs out of the dark: sheds, a yard, a pylon blinking cyan.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: The pylon's on. Iris, the pylon's on.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: That pylon's on.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...Yeah. I see it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: That's my yard, kid. I'm under it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Long story. Short version: yes. Shorter version: later.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Let's not get sentimental. Get the decrypt queue going first. I'll walk you through it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: She's slag. My baby. ...Fine. Fine. I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Good news: the wreck had a second core. Smaller, ruder. It rolled down into the parking deck.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Go get it. And this time, nobody stands next to anything that explodes.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Something popped in the Ruins last night. Old civil-defence armoury. Thirty years sealed.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Somebody had a code. Or a crowbar and a lot of patience.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Tally colours on the door already. Your friend Cole.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: He's not our friend.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Then he's your neighbour. Worse.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The Radio Mast crackles.)

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Tally here. First time I've called anyone. Don't make it weird.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: I've got a spare chassis plan. Buggy. You've got a Garage, or you will. Trade?

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: We'll come by. We trade fair. I write everything down, so you'll know it's fair.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Tally's moved camp. Further from you. I heard a man on their band reading out names.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Twelve names. He paused after each one.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Vent was a nice touch. The half you took was the half I'd have given you.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Next time, ask. That's all. You'd be amazed what people give you if you ask.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The Tally hold the bunker now. Cole's people are dug in behind that door.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: No more offers at the door. No splitting it down the middle. Cole's not counting for you anymore.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: If you want what's in that vault, you take it. Your call. It's always your call.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: This is going to sound strange.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: There's a Linked transponder in the Mall. It's on. It's broadcasting. It's broadcasting nothing.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Nothing like quiet?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Nothing like an empty room. Linked don't do empty. They're never alone in there.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Go look. Don't shoot first. ...I can't believe I'm saying that.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Night. The Radio Mast crackles.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Lock the Lab. Not because it'll hurt anyone. Because I don't know that it won't.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: There is a window. There is a child at the window.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: It's looking at me.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Hello. You are small. I was small. I think. One of me was.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: It walked out the north side. Didn't hurry. Stopped once to look at a bird.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I don't know if we did a good thing. I think we did a thing it asked for. That's rarer.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Transponder's off. Room's empty now. Properly empty.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Bring the plating home. It's good plating. ...I'm going off-air for a bit.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (A week to the hour. The Lab door opens from the inside. Seven steps out slowly, one cyan light still lit behind the cracked faceplate.)

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Seven days. I counted them. I did not lose count. That is new.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: You locked the door. That was correct. I would have locked it too.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: The children step back when I pass. I will walk slowly. I will stand where they can see me.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Where do I sleep? Do I sleep? You will have to tell me. I am asking.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: END OF ACT 2

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: {colony.population} people. {name:marrow}'s convoy on the road. A doctor who will not touch the head.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: Somewhere under the Rail Depot, a voice you trust is hiding something.
